aiMentor.title: Spiritual Mentor

aiMentor.placeholder: I need help, my heart is heavy...
aiMentor.dailyLimitReached: You've reached your daily limit. Come back tomorrow or get Premium for 30 questions per day.
aiMentor.suggestion1: My heart is heavy, which dhikr and dua should I read?
aiMentor.suggestion2: I want my family to be peaceful, what should I do?
aiMentor.suggestion3: Which prayers should I read for abundance and sustenance?

aiConsent.title: AI Data Sharing Consent
aiConsent.subtitle: Before using this feature, please review how your data is handled. Your explicit consent is required.
aiConsent.data_sent_value: Your typed questions, messages, and your selected app language are sent to an external AI service for processing.
aiConsent.provider_value: Google LLC — Google Gemini AI API, processed via Firebase Cloud Functions (Google servers).
aiConsent.purpose_value: To generate personalized spiritual advice, dhikr recommendations, and Quran verse suggestions based on your questions.
aiConsent.storage_value: Your messages are processed in real-time and are not permanently stored on Google or our servers after the response is generated.
